subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion via user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config boundary should that use?
rationale: Source review proves the gap, but the remaining change affects data visibility, OAuth scopes, token/subscription lifecycle, and operator consent, which need maintainer product and security intent before code work is safe.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered only, while finishing thread-reply reliability through narrower existing issues or PRs.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until a shared Google Workspace consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model is sponsored across plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of recent Google Chat review, thread-reply commit history, and security/config ownership signals.
